recipes.name: HSI
setup: Install requirements.txt, prepare BALROG data, and explicitly pass OPENAI_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_BASE environment names.
Provide bounded config overlays for the chosen benchmark; no game data or environments are installed by the adapter.

profiles.description: HSI hierarchical harness/meta-harness evolution with native BALROG benchmark evaluation

evaluation.description: HSI hierarchical harness/meta-harness evolution with native BALROG benchmark evaluation Metrics and validity retain the native evaluator contract.

argument_help: --config benchmark_config_goal/SELECTED/config.yaml overrides the default BabyAI profile; budgets/model are in the config.
limitations: Source and fixture checks only; dependencies, paid model calls and native end-to-end execution are not verified. Native metrics are not canonical Arena task receipts.
Source tracks .env; Arena removes only that file from the isolated workspace and never reads or hashes its contents.
Native benchmark runtime/data, game engines and initial harness repositories must be prepared. Unknown source license remains explicit.
